title: Resolve iMessage contact names safely
body: Resolve outbound recipient names through Seaglass/message history to a concrete Messages handle before drafting; reject unresolved or ambiguous names and avoid false-success sends.

log.text: Moving implementation into the required dedicated worktree
Implemented Seaglass chat-id recipient resolution, concrete-handle draft storage, ambiguous/group rejection, and asynchronous submission semantics.

Resolved contact names through Seaglass chat identity to concrete direct-chat handles; ambiguous, group, and unresolved recipients fail before drafting. Messages submissions no longer claim confirmed delivery. Live resolution succeeded and 68 iMessage tests pass.
